protocol_amendment.reason: The exact-commit V8 accounting and red-team reviews required revision before launch-plan design. They found that graph_cells reported a reservation-shaped candidate bound rather than executed dimensions, graph and expansion work was charged only after successful completion, caller-controlled path metadata could defeat bounded invalid receipts, generated construction was gated only at the CLI, final phase closure was not a validity invariant, and producer refusal diagnostics retained stale wording.
changes: Accept only the V9 document schema and reject V1-V8 without row verification.
Replace aggregate graph_cells with three explicit executed counters: graph candidate evaluations, eligible conflict checks, and eligible pair-output cells.
Charge every graph candidate, eligible conflict check, expansion formal, and eligible pair-output cell inside its executed loop so exceptions preserve exact partial lower bounds.
Reserve the three graph dimensions separately from authenticated source bounds and require each actual counter to be dominated by its matching reservation field.
Limit reflected input-path metadata to 4096 ASCII bytes or a bounded omission marker before report construction.
Require an otherwise successful report to match the exact V9 phase sequence and to close every unit phase with all expected units passed and zero failures.

Disable the public generated_curve constructor and reject every non-frozen build_density_row association before factor-base or row work; retain only private factor-base provenance controls and the exact frozen p=19 B4 density-row control.
Update producer refusal diagnostics to version 9.

Add controls that fail after the second charge of each graph or expansion dimension, suppress one successful primary-proof phase receipt, reflect an over-report-ceiling caller path through an invalid-budget receipt, and prove public construction guards precede generated-curve and factor-base work.
Keep every development family-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
The standalone complete five-field semantic oracle remains frozen-B4 only; B6 and B8 secondary objective fields remain deterministic replay confirmations.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: The in-process reservation and actual counters are structural combinatorial receipts, not CPU, wall-time, parser, allocator, RSS, disk, I/O, cache-traffic, or memory-bandwidth models.
Canonical B6 and B8 feasibility, output size, cache occupancy, and role resource use remain unmeasured.
The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, and immutable input/output paths.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V9 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design, not execution.
